n: The host connects to the microphone extension cable (YH-HTXL20)
d: The host connects to the microphone extension cable, a dual-shielded anti-interference dedicated cable. Used on-site to extend the distance between the host and the units. Each end is equipped with one aviation female connector and one 8-pin female connector. Standard length is 20 meters, with optional lengths available including 10m, 20m, 50m, 100m, etc.
